items.period: Shang dynasty; oracle-bone script style, modern vector rendering of a Xiaoxuetang glyph identified as 42.F100, 甲2827 合27941
items.caption: An oracle-bone form of 年, rendered with 禾 above a human-shaped element. It illustrates the museum’s early harvest interpretation; the form alone does not establish whether 人 also supplied sound.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone-style graph on white: a branching grain-like upper form above a separate human-shaped lower form.
items.selection_reason: The exact file description identifies this 年 form and attributes it to a specific Xiaoxuetang record. It provides a sourced example of the form used to explain the grain-and-person interpretation.
items.rights: The Commons description states CC0 1.0 for the Xiaoxuetang glyph image and public-domain status for the modern vector representation. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The selected rendering is a modern redraw. The pictorial account is supported by the museum, but the lower element’s possible phonetic role remains disputed; this research did not independently inspect a dated series of glyph images.
